name: emag
description: eM@g - Gestion de parc matériel et personnel (monorepo)

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint:fix --workspace=apps/api
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=apps/web && npm run format --workspace=apps/api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace=apps/web && npm run format:check --workspace=apps/api
scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix
scripts.ci:fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix
scripts.ci:local: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:syntax && npm run docs:check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.ci:local:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:syntax && npm run docs:check
scripts.test: node --test --test-force-exit tests/unit.test.js tests/schemas.test.js tests/db-init.test.js tests/audit-fixes.test.js tests/sav-comparator.test.js tests/cache.test.js tests/sentry.test.js tests/pagination.test.js tests/captcha.test.js tests/bp-items-grouping.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-force-exit tests/unit.test.js tests/schemas.test.js tests/db-init.test.js tests/audit-fixes.test.js tests/sprint4.test.js
